news.h: Burrow powers Bengals past the Falcons in Madrid for their 4th straight win
news.d: — Joe Burrow threw for three touchdowns and rushed for another and the Cincinnati Bengals' offense kept rolling to defeat the Atlanta Falcons 34-17 in Madrid on Sunday for their fourth straight win.

news.h: Joe Burrow makes time for art in Madrid ahead of Bengals-Falcons
news.d: While in Spain, the Bengals quarterback is finding time for one of his off-field interests: art.

news.h: Bengals' Burrow is looking to extend 3-game winning streak against Penix and Falcons in Madrid
news.d: Cincinnati's Joe Burrow. experienced dramatically different lead-in games to Sunday's matchup between the Bengals and Falcons in Madrid, Spain.

news.h: Joe Burrow throws 5 TD passes, then runs for score in OT as Bengals rally for 43-36 win over Titans
news.d: — Bengals defensive tackle Dexter Lawrence had some simple advice for Joe Burrow as the franchise quarterback prepared to take the field with Cincinnati trailing the Tennessee Titans by a touchdown in the fourth quarter.

news.h: Joe Burrow's trust makes Tee Higgins level up for Bengals
news.d: No receiver in the NFL has been better on tight window throws this season than the Bengals' Tee Higgins.
